sources.note: Annex 2, Cycle 2026: 5 research areas and 28 indicative sub-areas, all recorded (read from the PDF text)
Proposals must fall within the five research areas; candidates pick the best-fitting indicative sub-area from Annex 2

subject_rule: Limited to research themes: the Application Guide says proposals under the 2026 cycle 'should fall within' five research areas (Heritage Conservation and Management; AI for Sustainable Management of Natural Resources and Climate Action; Ethical, Inclusive and Human-Centred AI for Sustainable Development; AI for Sustainable Cities, Infrastructure and Societal Resilience; AI and Education), and candidates choose the best-matching of 28 indicative sub-areas; the applicant's master's degree only has to be in a field relevant to the proposed research.

notes: Recorded 28 research sub-areas for the postdoctoral level; Annex 2 states '5 Research Areas and 28 Indicative Sub-areas', so this is the full official list (heritage 4, natural resources and climate 5, ethical AI 6, cities and resilience 6, education 7).
These are research topics, not degree majors: the fellowship funds a 3 to 9 month research stay in Japan and the master's degree itself may be in any field relevant to the proposed research.
Annex 2 calls the sub-areas indicative; the page and guide do not say whether a proposal outside them is accepted, but they say proposals should fall within the five research areas.
The PDF layout scrambled the order of SC-6 to SC-8 and ED-7 in one extraction mode; wording was checked against a second extraction.
